declarations.name: Harsanyi.signed_gaussian_variance
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.{u_2} μ] (A : Finset.{u_1} α)
  (ε : α → Ω → Real) (c : α → Real) (b : Real) (σ2 : NNReal),
  (∀ (i : α), Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A i → Measurable.{u_2, 0} (ε i)) →
    (∀ (i : α),
        Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A i →
          Eq.{1} (MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{u_2, 0} (ε i) μ) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 σ2)) →
      (Set.Pairwise.{u_1} ↑A fun (i j : α) => ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.{u_2, 0, 0} (ε i) (ε j) μ) →
        (∀ (i : α), Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} A i → Eq.{1} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (c i) 2) 1) →
          Eq.{1}
            (ProbabilityTheory.variance.{u_2}
              (fun (ω : Ω) => HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} b (∑ i ∈ A, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (c i) (ε i ω))) μ)
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ↑(Finset.card.{u_1} A) ↑σ2)
declarations.title: 独立高斯交错和的方差
declarations.summary: 真实随机变量：常量加带 ±1 系数的有限独立高斯和，方差为项数乘 σ²。
assumptions: 概率测度；每项可测且分布为 N(0,σ²)；对所用项两两独立；c_i²=1。L² 从高斯分布推出。

declarations.name: Harsanyi.and_gaussian_variance
declarations.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_2} Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_2} Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.{u_2} μ] (T : Finset.{u_1} α)
  (ε : Finset.{u_1} α → Ω → Real) (I : Real) (σ2 : NNReal),
  (∀ (L : Finset.{u_1} α), Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (Finset.powerset.{u_1} T) L → Measurable.{u_2, 0} (ε L)) →
    (∀ (L : Finset.{u_1} α),
        Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (Finset.powerset.{u_1} T) L →
          Eq.{1} (MeasureTheory.Measure.map.{u_2, 0} (ε L) μ) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 σ2)) →
      (Set.Pairwise.{u_1} ↑(Finset.powerset.{u_1} T) fun (L K : Finset.{u_1} α) =>
          ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.{u_2, 0, 0} (ε L) (ε K) μ) →
        Eq.{1}
          (ProbabilityTheory.variance.{u_2}
            (fun (ω : Ω) =>
              HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} I
                (∑ L ∈ Finset.powerset.{u_1} T,
                  HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                    (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (-1) (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Finset.card.{u_1} T) (Finset.card.{u_1} L)))
                    (ε L ω)))
            μ)
          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} 2 (Finset.card.{u_1} T)) ↑σ2)

assumptions: n>1、1≤M≤n、p>0 及原三条件；M=n 与 μ1=0 包含；M=0 的另一读法问题单列。

    ∀ (τ : Real),
      LT.lt.{0} 0 τ →
        LE.le.{0} 0 (Harsanyi.Sparsity.meanOutput.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} g) N 1) →
          Ne.{1}
              (Harsanyi.Sparsity.cancellationRatio.{u_1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} g)) N k)
              0 →
            LE.le.{0}

                  (Harsanyi.Sparsity.salientFamily.{u_1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} (Harsanyi.centered.{u_1} g)) N k
                    τ)))
              (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}

declarations.title: 代入同一 T2 见证的计数界
declarations.summary: 把同一见证的原完整系数表示式实际代入显著交互计数，得到原 T3 展开。
assumptions: k∈[1,M]、τ>0、η≠0、μ1≥0；w 为真实 CoefficientWitness。

                                (abs.{0}

                                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} p (Harsanyi.Sparsity.CoefficientWitness.δ.{u_1} w))))
                                    (∑ i ∈ J,
